title: Aggregate milestone-oriented planning reports
description: Add renderer-neutral planning report types and aggregation. Apply an optional planning status plus all six grouping filters using the shared matcher, then construct a fixed project to version to milestone hierarchy. The root and every node contain totalItems and statusCounts in toplan, researched, planned, rejected order including zero buckets. Emit observed hierarchy values only, represent unset as an empty JSON value, preserve stored casing, keep differently cased buckets distinct, sort empty first then lexically, and avoid loading handoffs or executable stats. Add table-driven aggregation tests for empty data, partial metadata, combined filters, mixed casing, zero counts, and deterministic nested ordering.
